notes.title: Chef Master Arrives – First Battle with His Commentary!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="iDc5tHU6inU;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Chef Master has entered the kitchen – and the battlefield. [/h2][p]In this chaotic new video, the fizzy thief squad take on Bongo Banana’s delivery guards in a traffic-blocking showdown.[/p][p][/p][p]For the first time ever, Chef Master appears in the game as a commentary, roasting every move with sarcastic commentary like:[/p][p][i]“Guards are trapped in traffic. You’re trapped in self-satisfaction.”[/i][/p][p][i]“Victory by timeout – the culinary equivalent of burning toast and calling it gourmet.”[/i][/p][p][/p][p]🍋 Bottles blast. Bananas fly. Chaos reigns. Watch the full battle now and meet Chef Master – he’s not holding back.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: New Power-Up Alert: Shield added to the game
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550051/8e0a58c590b705acbe499ab8c88223bf41e67042.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Hotdog Guard is powered up and ready to sprint! 🌭💨[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This week, we’re adding a new power-up: 🛡️ [b]Shield [/b] – grants temporary invincibility against projectiles. Both [b]The Flaming Shoe[/b] and [b]Shield [/b]power-ups bubbles are visible on the minimap — so keep your eyes peeled! ⏱️ The Shield lasts for a limited time, and only one character can use it at a time. Use it wisely and time your moves![/p][p][/p][p]👀 You’ll also spot [b]Chef Master[/b] in the image — he’s just observing for now, but he’ll soon join the chaos as a commentator. Expect spice, sass, and possibly insults.[/p][p][/p][p]🎥 [b]Watch the video here to see the shield in action:[/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="CtILxSk0zPs;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Gameplay Video: Fizzmeister Frank in Action
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="eLgipZPP8SY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Join us for a new gameplay showcase of [b]Fizzmeister Frank[/b] – where tactical chaos meets fizzy fun.[/p][p]In this video, you’ll experience:[/p][list][*][p]🎙️ Hilarious and character-driven voice lines[/p][/*][*][p]🔥 The legendary [b]Flaming Shoe[/b] for burst-speed movement[/p][/*][*][p]🔫 [b]Ammo Bubbles[/b] that turn every encounter into a spectacle[/p][/*][*][p]🌀 [b]Teleporters[/b] with flashy effects and strategic possibilities[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Server Host Powers: Infinite Ammo Mode Unleashed!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="7ALzPrXnAeI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]🆕 New Feature Alert: **Infinite Ammo Mode** is now available!  [/p][p]The server host can activate this custom setting, turning any match into a full-blown shootout with unlimited firepower.[/p][p]In our latest video, the Bongo Banana team (4 Steam friends) faces off against the Cherry Pop cupcakes in a chaotic delivery mission. We're the guards, they're the thieves—and with infinite ammo, things get wild fast.[/p][p][/p][p]💥 Expect:[/p][p]- Non-stop shooting[/p][p]- Respawns at The Slippery Sip[/p][p]- Flaming Shoe speed boosts[/p][p]- Cupcake takedowns and sign destruction[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🚨 New Update: Teleporters Are Here! 🚨
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="58S50ETWhRg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’ve added teleporters to the game — and it’s pure chaos! 🌀 There are 4 teleporters inside GoatFish Labs, each leading to a different part of the Town. A giant screen shows the destinations on the city map, and each teleporter has its own sci-fi panel with blinking lights. It’s cartoonish, it’s high-tech, and it’s totally Fizzmeister.[/p][p]Naturally, we had to make a gameplay video where the Thief Team (us 4 Steam friends playing as Fizzmeister Frank bottles) test the teleporters... while getting ambushed by Cupcake Vanilla Vibe (the computer controlled guards). 💥🍰[/p][p]Expect shootouts, respawns, and teleporting — but also teamwork and laughs.[/p]

notes.title: Run Like Fire – New Speed Boost Item Added!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="oxJRB3HoRI0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]We just added the Flaming Shoe to the game – and it’s fast.[/b] This new item gives you a serious speed boost and a fiery edge. Whether you're racing through the city or outrunning your friends, the Flaming Shoe will definitely spice things up.[/p]

notes.title: Introducing Voice Lines! Soda Pop Steve vs Banana Bongo Battle
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="BlH7ZX2BR3k;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’re excited to present our latest gameplay clip featuring the intense battle between Soda Pop Steve and the guard team Bongo Banana - recorded during our recent team match![/p][p]Voice lines have been integrated into our gameplay, adding a whole new layer of immersion, humor, and personality to every encounter. Expect teasing reactions, clever one-liners, and dynamic feedback as players engage in the most chaotic showdown yet.[/p][p]🎮 Match Highlights:[/p][p]Team Thief (Soda Pop Steve) vs Team Guard (Bongo Banana)[/p][p]Respawn zone: Lemonade Bliss[/p][p]Funny voice lines[/p][p]Strategic gameplay and funny moments[/p][p]A surprise twist ending - the bananas deliver the box![/p][p]Watch the full clip on YouTube and experience the action with voice![/p]

notes.title: 🍌 Welcome to The Slippery Sip – Home of Bongo Banana
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550051/bd7f971c0444e149047f807e1a2d3b61d89fa013.png"][/img][/p][p]Step into Bongo Banana’s turf: [b]The Slippery Sip[/b].  A carefully crafted space where every detail—from the oversized bar counter to the towering tropical mixer - radiates chaotic calm. It's not just a bar. It's where bananas go to become legends.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550051/d6c4cef9f7cccd3a629f24d2f58419024e45341e.png"][/img][/p][p]Neon signs flicker. Bongo poses like he owns the place (he kinda does).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550051/65c1ce349a6c9d857091c0b8a4df0f31347fd805.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Behind the bar, behind the scenes. Bongo’s not just serving vibes - he’s delivering them.[/i] A quick glance at the register. A backpack full of promise. He’s ready.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550051/1e1a438470ba49f7806956369f57e61abfe215c8.png"][/img][/p][p][i]The city waits. The cargo’s loaded. And Bongo Banana... never misses a drop.[/i] Lights ahead, peel to the pedal. The Slippery Sip was just the beginning.[/p]

notes.notes:
Hey there, Food Fighters! GoatFish Studios is thrilled to bring you Battle Food Mania – a chaotic action game where crazy, cartoonish food characters battle it out in a quirky neighborhood with over-the-top weapons and nonstop mayhem! 🌟

We’re super excited to have you join our community hub, the perfect place to share your thoughts, ideas, and excitement for the game. Jump into the madness, tell us about your favorite wacky weapons, or just hang out as we prepare for the big launch.

🍟 Stay tuned for more ridiculous updates! 🎯 And don’t forget to add Battle Food Mania to your Wishlist!

Let the mania begin – it’s time to bring on the chaos!
